source_observations: HookPoint is an identity module by default and supports forward/backward PyTorch hooks whose returned activation can replace the intermediate value, enabling interventions rather than passive logging.
TransformerLens provides activation caching/patching/path-patching machinery oriented to mechanistic interpretability and model-internal causal experiments.
ArchitectureBridge/AutoBridge and architecture-specific conversion code convert supported Hugging Face models into HookedTransformer form.
Qwen2ForCausalLM has explicit conversion support in the audited source, including embeddings, attention Q/K/V/O, norms, MLP and unembedding weights.
No equally explicit Qwen3ForCausalLM compatibility was established in this E1 audit; exact target ~0.8B compatibility therefore remains UNKNOWN.
The current package dependency surface is materially heavier than a minimal custom hook probe (Torch, Transformers, datasets, accelerate, wandb and others).
hypothesis_update: SUPPORTED_AT_SOURCE_LEVEL: controlled activation replacement can be used to test whether an injected/broadcast vector causes a downstream model-state or output delta on a compatible local model.
counterhypothesis_update: REMAINS_LIVE: architecture conversion cost/semantic drift and dependency weight may make pyvene or a narrow native PyTorch-hook harness superior for the exact ~0.8B target.
non_inference_boundaries: Source support does not prove the exact target model loads or converts faithfully.
Activation intervention does not prove F2 system-level GWT uptake unless event/generation/vector identities are bound across the F2 causal path.
Hook/cached activation values are measurements/candidates, never canonical world facts.
No runtime experiment was executed by this E1 source audit.
No runtime, physical GRID10, whole-F2, whole-EntityOS/HCU or training credit is granted.

criteria: single-layer controlled activation injection and reversible rescue
stable hook-point naming / vector shape ABI
ability to fail closed on unsupported architecture or shape
recommended_next_discriminator.promotion_gate: Only after E2 establishes exact compatibility should a deterministic E3 local intervention fixture be claimed.
